findings.problem: readInput/writeExclusive clear descriptor only after closeSync returns. If closeSync throws after closing or with ambiguous close disposition, finally retries the same numeric descriptor. A reused descriptor can belong to an unrelated file. Failure still refuses, but unrelated descriptor safety is not preserved.
counterexample_steps: Intercept target input or output close only.
Close the target descriptor through the original close function.
Open an unrelated temporary regular file so the descriptor number is reused.
Current finally calls closeSync on that reused descriptor again.
findings.required_change: Clear the owned descriptor before the one close attempt. Preserve refusal/uncertain output and never unlink. Add a meaningful close-after-close/reused-FD regression for both reader and writer.
